title: Braised Festive Block with Malt and Beer
description: A hearty, comforting dish perfect for cold winter nights. The malty flavor pairs well with the braise sauce and the festive block adds a pop of color.

ingredients.name: Malty
ingredients.notes: malt extract or dry malt powder

instructions: Season the festive block with salt.
Heat the beer in a pan over medium heat.
Add the malty to the beer and stir to combine.
Add the braise to the beer mixture and stir to combine.
Add the festive block to the pan and cover with a lid.
Braise the block in the oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the block from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Serve the block with the braising liquid spooned over the top.
